chapter 9 Joyful Movement 
activity 73 exploring exercise 
vs. movement
for you to know
At the movies in the mall, I’ve noticed that most people take the escalator, rather than walking up 
the stairs. No matter how crowded the escalator, people just avoid the stairs. I see this happening 
in lots of other places too. I don’t think people do this because they’re necessarily lazy. Instead, 
I think it’s probably because many people have black-and-white ideas about exercise. To them, 
exercise means working out at the gym or running a few miles on the street. If they’ve already 
exercised that day, they think, Why bother walking upstairs? The rest of the time, they can justify 
being sedentary. And others don’t even think about moving at all!
for you to do
For a week, keep track of the ways you move (both simple movement and exercise), and mark how 
each feels. (You might need to add two checks for some.) The first couple of rows were how Luke
